name: Etapp 8: Fagerhult - Mullsjö / Hotel Mullsjö
estimatedTime: about 7 hours 30 minutes for the two current Naturkartan/Smålandsleden split records
description: Fagerhult / Gagnån stage-7/8 junction to Hotel Mullsjö / Mullsjö. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Hotel Mullsjö tap / service water: Official PDF says drinking water is available from a tap at the back of Hotel Mullsjö; Naturkartan ledstart lists drinking water.
notes: Overview/PDF sources treat Etapp 8 as one numbered stage, while current Smålandsleden/Naturkartan exposes it as two VV8 records: Fagerhult-Furusjö and Furusjö-Mullsjö Hotell.
Downloadable VV8 mainline GPX starts/continues at the Gagnån VV7/VV8 junction, not Fagerhult village. Fagerhult is represented by a separate connector.
Official overview/PDF says 29 km; current Naturkartan split records sum to 29.8 km; logistics PDF says 30.9 km; OSM tag/wiki says 31 km while computed OSM/E1 geometry is about 29.8 km.
Both current Naturkartan VV8 split GPX files are stored south-to-north relative to official Fagerhult -> Mullsjö planning order.
Naturkartan endpoint is 57.903080,13.872020, while OSM/E1 endpoint is around 57.9042,13.8706, about 140-150 m away.
Sources vary between 1.8 km, 1.9 km and 2.3 km for the Hotel Mullsjö-Mullsjö center/station access route.

facilities.name: Fagerhult VV7/VV8 ledstart
facilities.description: Trail/access start behind Fagerhults Belysning factory. Naturkartan and Habo sources indicate parking by the trail/local exercise tracks, with bus access on road 195. Not a shelter/camping/rest facility. Do not use as continuous mainline start.
facilities.routeProximity: on Fagerhult connector; about 0.817-0.9 km from Gagnån mainline

facilities.name: Furusjö VV8 entrance
facilities.description: Official split/access point in Furusjö with parking, bathing and bus connection. Useful for breaking the stage into the two Naturkartan VV8 records. Avoid duplicating Furusjöbadet amenities if both are imported.

facilities.name: Furusjöbadet grill/rest area
facilities.description: Grill area with benches/tables by Furusjön near the Furusjö split/access point. Adjacent bathing place, playground, boules court and volleyball court; kiosk and toilets are daytime/summer-season services. Treat kiosk and toilets as seasonal/daytime only. No drinking water confirmed.

facilities.name: Hornsjön windbreak
facilities.description: New windbreak along Västra Vätterleden Etapp 8 / Smålandsleden, usable for a pause or overnight. Page notes a fire site, a bin, and uneven ground from road down to the shelter. Older 2021 PDF names Hornsjön mainly as parking, so this appears newer than the PDF. No potable water indicated.
facilities.routeProximity: near/on VV8 Fagerhult-Furusjö; exact chainage pending route-buffer measure

facilities.name: Hotel Mullsjö ledstart
facilities.description: Official Hotel Mullsjö endpoint/trail start for Västra/Södra Vätterleden and local trails. Naturkartan lists information boards, parking and drinking water. PDF adds lodging/restaurant, bus stop and parking in front, a tap at the back of the hotel, and bathing/WC north of the hotel by Mullsjön. Potable tap reliability depends on hotel access/opening; confirm public access before runtime import.

facilities.name: Södra Kroksjön shelter cluster
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest cluster along VV8/Smålandsleden with shelter, fireplace/grill and benches. PDF and Habo/Naturkartan context also indicate dry toilet/TC, table group, simple bathing place and parking on the northeast side. Do not import nature reserve/Natura 2000 status for Södra Kroksjön from non-local Kroksjön search hits. Tent spots and drive-up access claims from non-official sources need caution; official camping/tenting permission was not confirmed.
facilities.routeProximity: on or very near VV8; PDF places Södra Kroksjön about 7.1 km after the Gagnån/Fagerhult junction context

facilities.name: Hotel Mullsjö tap / service water
facilities.description: Official PDF says drinking water is available from a tap at the back of Hotel Mullsjö; Naturkartan ledstart lists drinking water.
